name: tillbooks
description: Swiss accounting your agent can actually use: the TILL ledger over MCP.
long_description: TILL (Trusted Independent Ledger Library) is a local-first Swiss accounting engine your agent drives over MCP: it posts double-entry journal entries, categorises and chases invoices, and prepares the MWST-Abrechnung. This extension runs `till mcp` as a local stdio server on your own machine. Your books stay on your disk; the extension opens no outbound socket. If no database exists yet, the first tool call that needs one guides you to create_workspace or restore_backup.

db_path.title: Ledger database path
db_path.description: Path to your TILL SQLite ledger. Leave blank for the default (~/.till/till.db). The extension bundles no database; point this at an existing .till.db to adopt it.

support_dir.title: Support directory
support_dir.description: Where TILL keeps machine-scoped state (diagnostics, backups). Leave blank for the default (~/.till).
